description: This file contains unit tests for SQL Server persistence storage within the Orleans framework, focusing on relational storage operations including writing, reading, and concurrency tests.

classes.name: SqlServerStorageTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server relational storage functionality in Orleans, inheriting from RelationalStorageTests and implementing various persistence tests.

methods.name: WriteReadCyrillic
methods.description: Tests writing and reading of Cyrillic data in SQL Server storage.

methods.name: WriteReadWriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Tests concurrent write and read operations for 100 states.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Tests hash collision scenarios with storage data sets.

methods.name: WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate writes fail with an exception indicating inconsistent state.

methods.name: WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that inconsistent writes fail appropriately.

methods.name: StorageDataSetPlain_IntegerKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with plain integer key data sets.

methods.name: StorageDataSetPlain_GuidKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage operations with Guid key data sets.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_StorageDataSetPlain_StringKey_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage with string key data sets.

methods.name: DataSet2_Cyrillic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests storage with Cyrillic string IDs and names.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_IntegerKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests generic storage operations with integer keys.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_GuidKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests generic storage operations with Guid keys.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_StringKey_Generic_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests generic storage operations with string keys.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_StringKey_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization/deserialization for string key data sets.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_StringKey_Binary_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests binary serialization/deserialization for string key data sets.
